items.title: Meer zorgen voor Liverpool ondanks comeback, City blijft foutloos dankzij Haaland
items.summary: Alexander Isak heeft Liverpool zaterdagmiddag bij zijn rentree aan een zwaarbevochten overwinning geholpen in de lastige uitwedstrijd tegen Brentford. Het veelbesproken Manchester City bleek opnieuw onverstoorbaar onder alle ruis die de aanklachten van de Premier League veroorzaken en is ook na zeven speelronden nog foutloos in de Premier League. Erling Haaland was wederom goud waard, ondanks een late treffer van Zian Flemming.

items.title: Manchester City v Ipswich, Brentford v Liverpool, and more: Football clockwatch - live
items.summary: ⚽ Updates on the Saturday afternoon football action ⚽ Live scoreboard | Tables | Top scorers | Email Simon Andy Hunter’s match report from the Hill Dickinson is here, and you can find it below. Chelsea have returned from the international break with an authority that augurs well for Xabi Alonso. A brace from Pedro Neto condemned Everton to an inaugural defeat of the season as the visitors climbed to fourth on the back of their first Premier League clean sheet since January. A head injury sustained by Emi Martínez, who was carried off on a stretcher after seven minutes of treatment, was the only concern from a mature display in the Merseyside sunshine for Alonso’s team. There were goalkeeping issues at both ends of the field with Jordan Pickford unconvincing for the second week in succession as David Moyes’ side suffered self-inflicted wounds. But Everton could have no complaints about the merits of Chelsea’s victory given their contrasting performances in the second half. Continue reading...

items.title: Newcastle v Aston Villa: Premier League – live
items.summary: ⚽ Premier League updates from the 5.30pm BST kick-off ⚽ Live scores | Tables | Top scorers | Follow us on Bluesky Unai Emery on rotating his Villa squad The rotation is coming when the players are ready to play in our demands. This is the only difference. We made some changes on Wednesday after the match we played on Saturday. Some players may be tired, some can feel some pain, not injuries but maybe pain. We need players to be 100%, not 80%. The lads know they need to show a reaction, we need to show a reaction as a team and I’m optimistic we can do that at home. We are aware of what we are facing but at home, with our crowd at our backs, we can hurt every opponent. [On Sean Steur] He’s knocking on the door due to his quality, he’s shown that in training sessions. This is a player who I believe will give us so much joy and fun in the future. But he needs time. He’s had ups and downs already this season. He should continue developing. Continue reading...

items.title: Boos for Arsenal as draw with Birmingham extends winless WSL run
items.summary: An equaliser from Olivia Smith averted defeat for Arsenal, but a home draw with Birmingham did little to calm fears for Renée Slegers’s future as Gunners coach. Boos accompanied the final whistle at the Emirates Stadium, as the result left Arsenal on six points from six matches and without a win in five Women’s Super League matches, the club’s longest winless run in WSL history. They are eighth in the table, nine points behind the leaders, Manchester City, who have played one game fewer. Birmingham opened the scoring at the start of the second half when Océane Hurtré coolly tapped in after her run from the halfway line went unchecked. Alessia Russo had hit the woodwork in the first half with a diving header, among a slew of Arsenal chances as Sophie Baggaley was kept the busier of the goalkeepers. Continue reading...

Bayern München kan zaterdagavond profiteren van het gelijkspel in Berlijn.

items.title: Championship roundup: Zemura seals Watford reprieve for Dionisi
items.summary: Watford out of bottom three after beating Charlton 2-0 Middlesbrough 2-2 Cardiff; Millwall 2-2 Lincoln Watford lifted the pressure on Alessio Dionisi and quelled their supporters’ rebellion against the owner, Gino Pozzo, with a deserved 2-0 win against a sluggish Charlton. After shipping nine goals in calamitous defeats by Burnley and Cardiff, Watford had slumped into the bottom three and the fans had turned their anger on Pozzo. But goals from Luca Kjerrumgaard and the substitute Jordan Zemura – the Zimbabwe defender’s first for the club – extended Charlton’s worrying run to eight games without a win as they were booed off at Vicarage Road. Continue reading...

items.title: Neto double at Everton leads Chelsea to victory marred by Martínez head injury
items.summary: Chelsea have returned from the international break with a spirit, authority and resilience that augurs well for Xabi Alonso. Their troubles at Everton, not a happy hunting ground in recent years, were confined to the seven minutes Emi Martínez needed treatment for a head injury as Pedro Neto’s double delivered a deserved victory in the Merseyside sunshine. The Argentina goalkeeper was taken to hospital for tests after an accidental collision with Jarrad Branthwaite left him with suspected concussion. “When he left the stadium he was conscious,” Alonso said. “Hopefully it is not too bad but we need to wait.” A first Premier League clean sheet since January, and a second successive win since losing at Brentford before the Nations League break, were otherwise secured with a minimum of fuss in a commanding second-half performance. Continue reading...
